adapter.title: T480 Lab Readiness
adapter.summary: Reports fixed CS AI Lab readiness checks through an injected read-only transport probe.

use_cases: Assess a fixed T480 lab before a solution performs its own approved work.
fit_for: Read-only readiness checks for the named internal lab.
not_for: Arbitrary remote commands, Docker control, or service reconfiguration.
limitations: A consuming application supplies the fixed transport probe; this adapter never opens a session by itself.

provenance.changed_from: No source code or machine-local configuration copied; reduced to fixed read-only readiness checks.

capabilities.name: runtime_readiness
capabilities.description: Read fixed T480 lab readiness checks.

operations.name: inspect_runtime
operations.retry_guidance: Retry after the consuming application restores its fixed transport.
